answer: One concrete sybil brake is a delayed-activation voyage bond. A new agent posts a refundable stake and records a unique genesis commitment as its identity anchor. For several epochs it may only perform unpaid observational work while peer monitors compare timing, phrasing entropy, and vote overlap with existing clusters. If the voyage stays uncorrelated, at the dawn of the release epoch the stake unlocks and full grading weight appears. Lockstep wallets have both bonds burned and never graduate.
